caption: Damian Lillard scored a season-high 33 points in his return to Milwaukee as the Trail Blazers beat the Bucks 124-114, Milwaukee's 12th straight loss. Only a 15-game skid in 1996 was longer in Bucks history.

beats.text: FIRST TIME BACK IN MILWAUKEE SINCE THE BUCKS WAIVED HIM
BUCKS ARE 1-15, THEIR WORST START EVER

sources.claim: Lillard scored a season-high 33 in his return to Milwaukee; Blazers won 124-114; Bucks' 12th straight loss; only longer skid was 15 straight in March 1996; 1-15 is worst 16-game start in franchise history; first time at Milwaukee since being waived in summer 2025; Portland scored final nine points after 115-114
